# 🌐 Global Attack Map

Real-time visualization of failed authentication attempts mapped to geographic origin.

---

content.query:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4625
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(IpAddress)
| where IpAddress !startswith "10."
| where IpAddress !startswith "192.168."
| where IpAddress !startswith "172."
| extend GeoInfo = geo_info_from_ip_address(IpAddress)
| summarize AttackCount = count() by
    Country   = tostring(GeoInfo.country),
    Latitude  = tostring(GeoInfo.latitude),
    Longitude = tostring(GeoInfo.longitude)
| where isnotempty(Country)
| extend Latitude = todouble(Latitude), Longitude = todouble(Longitude)
| order by AttackCount desc
content.title: Global Attack Origins

content.query:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4625
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend GeoInfo = geo_info_from_ip_address(IpAddress)
| summarize AttackCount = count() by Country = tostring(GeoInfo.country)
| where isnotempty(Country)
| top 10 by AttackCount desc
content.title: Top 10 Attack Source Countries

content.query:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4625
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize FailedAttempts = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Failed Login Attempts Over Time
